title: El Niño Super El Niño — CPC single most likely outcome, ECMWF 100%, Kelvin wave +8°C
snippet: CPC now calls Super El Niño the 'single most likely outcome' for late 2026. ECMWF reached 100% probability. Subsurface Kelvin wave +8°C (50-250m depth) propagating east — warmer than 1997-98 event at same stage. SST anomalies may reach +3°C, rivaling strongest El Niño in recorded history (1877-78). IRI 97-98% probability through forecast period.
tag_reason: 기존 temp-evt-1902(El Niño 96%)의 후속: CPC가 Super El Niño를 '단일 가장 유력 결과'로 상향. ECMWF 100% 달성. Kelvin wave +8°C가 1997-98 동기를 초과하는 역사적 수치. 유의미한 에스컬레이션.
